resources.string: Invitation ready. Ask your family member to sign in with that Google account.

Only a family administrator can replace shared finances. You can still export a backup.
Recovery belongs to another Google account on this phone. Sign out, then sign in with the account that started it to continue. Current data is kept.
If the restoring phone is unavailable, an administrator can cancel after 25 minutes and keep the previous finances.
Restoring finances. If interrupted, recovery continues automatically when the app reconnects.
Finances restored. Remaining background work will retry automatically.
An administrator is restoring family finances. Your current data is kept until the replacement is ready.
Join this family and use its finances on this phone? Existing local finances will be replaced and kept separately for export. They will not be uploaded.
